description: Two invariants about intent files are enforced by nothing. First, an intent's scope lists files only: a directory, a trailing slash or a glob character widens the touch set and blocks every other flow at Stage 3 admission. Second, no text in an intent, and nothing added to a target repository, may name the control-plane repository's task-tracking directory, its agent-instruction directory, its scratch directory or a four-digit task id, because the intent text is copied into the append-only intents ledger. Today only an agent remembering the rule keeps these out.
goal: Make both invariants machine-checked. (1) 'holon intent-check' fails (exit 2 with a plain explanation, also in --json) on a scope entry that is an existing directory, ends in a slash or contains a glob character (star, question mark, bracket, brace), and warns on known hub files (flow/lazy_exports.py, any conftest.py, any docs/*.md file and scripts/pre_commit_check.py); it also fails when any text field of the intent (goal, description, rationale, scope, acceptance criteria) matches the harness-reference patterns. (2) Stage 1 refuses the same intents through the validation path that both the host-side Stage 1 and the intent creator already share, so a bad intent never reaches the intents ledger. (3) A new standalone script scans the lines a pull request adds, and the pull request body, for the harness-reference patterns, fails closed when it cannot read the diff, and runs from a new CI workflow on pull requests. Put the patterns in one new shared module, built from fragments so no source or test file contains a literal match of its own pattern. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Hand-kept rules slip; the same refusal at intent-check, at Stage 1 and in CI means no agent has to remember it, and the shape rule keeps overlap admission meaningful.
acceptance_criteria: intent_payload_rules.py rejects a scope entry that is a directory, ends in a slash or holds a glob character, and reports hub files as warnings only; test_intent_payload_rules.py proves it fails on a real violation (a directory entry, a star glob and a reconstructed intent whose text names a harness directory) and passes on a clean intent.

harness_reference_patterns.py is the single source of the patterns, assembled from fragments; test_check_no_harness_references.py proves the scan fails on an added line and on a pull request body that carry a reference (built at run time, never written literally in the test file) and passes on a clean diff and body, and that an unreadable diff fails closed.

scripts/check_no_harness_references.py exits non-zero on a violation and is run by .github/workflows/test-no-harness-references.yml on pull requests; the workflow file is new and no existing workflow file is edited.

cli/commands/intent_check.py exits 2 for a violating intent in text and --json form and keeps exit 0/1 for clean intents; tests in tests/cli/test_intent_check_cli.py and tests/test_intent_scope_check.py cover both and the existing proposal behaviour is unchanged. intent_scope_check.py gains only the thin call into intent_payload_rules.py.

flow/intent_questions.py reports an intent with a bad scope entry or a harness reference as unresolved so the host Stage 1 and the intent creator both refuse it; tests/flow/test_intent_questions.py proves the refusal and that a clean intent still passes. Do not edit flow/stages/intent.py, flow/lazy_exports.py, flow/context.py or any conftest.py.

No docstrings and no comments except '# why:' in anything added; every new module is at most 200 lines; holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged; 'uv run pytest' on the new and touched tests, 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
